subject: Post-call: evidence handover, retention windows, and pen-test timing
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Erica Stone <erica@veritapay.com>; Samir Khan <samir@veritapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: evidence handover, retention windows, and pen-test timing

Thanks again for the time earlier — good to align. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can get you what Infosec needs without blocking your procurement timeline.

Highlights / Pain points you reiterated:
- SOC 2 scope for production-only ingestion (no PII stored long-term).
- Audit log retention requirement: 13 months by audit team, with ability to export logs for eDiscovery.
- Pen-test: vendor will need temporary access to a staging environment; you asked about an isolated window and a point-of-contact.

What we agreed we would deliver by next touch (May 7):
1) DDQ matrix with mapping to artifacts (SOC 2 controls, screenshots, and links) — Hannah to deliver (attached: redwood_ddq_matrix.xlsx).
2) Proposed retention table showing default retention, export process, and exception handling — Hannah to deliver (attached: retention_windows.csv).
3) Pen-test scope draft and suggested timing; include standard rules-of-engagement and staging access checklist — Ben will draft and loop in our infra team.

Open questions for you (please confirm):
- Confirm preferred pen-test window (two-week window in June vs. one-week in late May).
- Will VeritaPay accept a scoped SOC 2 artifact package (evidence bundles + auditor letter) or do you require the full report?
- Who will be the formal owner on your side for DDQ sign-off (I heard Samir but wanted to confirm).

Attachments: redwood_ddq_matrix.xlsx (DDQ mapping), retention_windows.csv (proposed retention policy table).

Next internal owners: Hannah (evidence + retention), Ben (pen-test scope + infra coordination), Marissa (contract / DPA redline support).

If that captures it, I’ll send the DDQ and retention CSV by EOD Thursday (May 7) and Ben will push a pen-test scope draft the following day.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_ddq_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: retention_windows.csv (text/csv)]

From: Erica Stone <erica@veritapay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir@veritapay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: evidence handover, retention windows, and pen-test timing

Thanks Hannah — this is great and aligned with what we discussed. A few quick answers:
- Pen-test window: we prefer the two-week window in June (June 7–20) to give internal teams time to prep.
- SOC 2: we generally accept an artifact bundle + management letter for initial security gating; we may request the full report later during procurement but artifact bundle is fine for now.
- DDQ owner: Samir will be the primary owner, I’ll be copied. Samir, I’ll put you in touch with legal when we start DPA redlines.

Two asks from our side: 1) Can you include the log schema (fields and retention tag) in the retention table? 2) For the pen-test, can you propose a staging access template (time-limited creds / jumpbox approach) we can review with our security ops?

If you can get the DDQ and retention + schema by Friday that would keep us on track. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Erica
Director, Security Programs
VeritaPay

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: evidence handover, retention windows, and pen-test timing

Internal note — forwarding Erica's confirmation. Action items for infra / security coordination:
- I will draft the pen-test scope and the rules-of-engagement doc by EOD May 6. Will include staging access checklist and recommended jumpbox pattern.
- Need a quick internal signoff from the infra team on temporary credential provisioning; I’ll loop Richard Lee (thirdpartysec) to propose an ops runbook.
- Hannah: when you send the DDQ, include the log schema column (sample field names / retention tag) as Erica requested. I’ll drop the pen-test scope into the shared drive and post the link.

Planning note: ensure we don’t include production write access for the tester; readonly access + synthetic data where possible.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_pen_test_scope.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Erica Stone <erica@veritapay.com>, Samir Khan <samir@veritapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Richard Lee <richard@thirdpartysec.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2026 09:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: evidence handover, retention windows, and pen-test timing — DDQ + retention table attached

Erica / Samir — attaching the updated DDQ mapping and retention table that include the log schema column (see sheet: audit_logs).

What’s attached:
- redwood_ddq_matrix.xlsx — each DDQ question mapped to our control, artifact name, and link to an evidence bundle. I added a short note where we need a DPA exception (rare).
- retention_windows.csv — default retention per artifact, export path, and a sample log schema column (field_name: event_ts, user_id, action, resource_id, retention_tag).
- redwood_pen_test_scope.pdf — Ben attached our draft scope and rules-of-engagement.

Immediate asks from our side to keep June window:
- Samir — confirm VeritaPay pen-test point-of-contact and external vendor name so we can share access instructions with Richard.
- Erica — confirm whether artifact bundles should be delivered to a file share (preferred) or uploaded into your procurement portal.

If we don’t hear objections, we’ll schedule a quick 30-minute runbook review with your SecOps and Richard on May 12 (proposed). I’ll create the calendar invite after Samir confirms availability.

Thanks — Hannah
